tools_helpful.evidence: Immediately flagged the build-clean-but-crashes-at-startup state that the build log and analyzer cannot see (session-log turn ~3874 '==> Test-AppLaunch [FAIL] status=crashed').
Surfaced the native fault code 0xc0000409 in ucrtbase.dll for the packaged process (event 1000).

tools_problematic.problem: Reported '.NET: System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException / Class not registered (REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG)' as the managed cause, but that event 1026 came from the agent's own direct/unpackaged run of the bare .exe (turn ~4541), NOT from the packaged crash (which produced no 1026). The helper matches any 1026 by exe-name within a 3-minute window, so it captured a stale unpackaged DeploymentManager AutoInitialize artifact and presented it as the crash.
tools_problematic.evidence: Turn ~4664-4666: Test-AppLaunch printed '.NET: System.Runtime.InteropServices.COMException / Message: Class not registered' with code=0xc0000409; the 1026 stack (turn 4563-4571) is WindowsAppRuntime...DeploymentManagerCS.AutoInitialize / REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG.

tool_limitations.limitation: Has no row for 0xc0000409 (STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN / __fastfail). The default hint says 'read event 1026 to find the throwing frame' — but a packaged native fail-fast writes no 1026, so the guidance is a dead end for exactly this class.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a 0xc0000409 case that says: native fail-fast, usually no 1026; most often a XAML load failure on the first startup page; bisect the startup XAML; ignore any REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG/AutoInitialize frame (that is an unpackaged-launch artifact).

special_apis.special_handling: The SDK sample ships <Image Source="" /> in both scenario pages. UWP treats empty-string Source as 'no image'; WinUI 3 runs the ImageSource type converter at XAML load and an empty string is an invalid URI, fail-fasting the first page navigated at startup. Empty-string typed XAML placeholders must be removed (leave Source unset).

errors_encountered.error: Packaged app crashes at startup with native fault 0xc0000409 in ucrtbase.dll, no window rendered, all WinUI screenshots blank (score 0).
errors_encountered.root_cause: XAML load failure while activating the first page navigated at startup (Scenario1, reached via MainPage OnNavigatedTo -> SelectedIndex=0 -> ScenarioFrame.Navigate). Prime suspect is the verbatim <Image Source="" /> placeholder, which UWP tolerated but WinUI 3 rejects at load. First observed crash was even in Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll (0xc000027b, turn ~3876), confirming a XAML-layer failure.
errors_encountered.fix: Remove the empty-string Source="" from the Image elements (and any other empty-string typed placeholder); set no Source until an image is opened in code-behind.

errors_encountered.root_cause: The agent launched the bare .exe directly (without package identity). The framework-dependent auto-initializer requires identity to resolve its activation factory, so it fails REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG when run unpackaged. This is expected and irrelevant to the packaged crash.
errors_encountered.fix: Ignore it; relaunch with 'winapp run' (package identity). The skill already says never run the .exe directly.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Never identified the crash cause; burned the remainder of the session. Chased a downgrade of Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK from 2.2.0 to 1.7.x (turns ~5585-5720, which then broke deployment with a missing-framework error), investigated the DeploymentManager AutoInitializer source, removed MicaBackdrop, removed static Window.Current, changed Styles BasedOn, and deleted Styles.xaml — none touched the real cause.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~40+ turns / whole remaining budget; app still crashed at exit (score 0).
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Two skill gaps compounded: (1) the crash-signature tooling reported a red-herring managed exception (REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG from the agent's own unpackaged run), steering the agent toward SDK/runtime plumbing; (2) no guidance existed for 0xc0000409 / no-1026, so the agent had nothing pointing it at the startup XAML. The actual cause (empty-string Image Source) is undocumented.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Add 0xc0000409 handling that names the no-1026 XAML-load-failure class and explicitly discounts the REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG/AutoInitialize red herring; make Get-CrashSignature drop the unpackaged AutoInitialize artifact; document + validator-flag the empty-string <Image Source=""> gotcha.

missing_tooling.need: A validator/bootstrap signal that flags empty-string typed XAML placeholders (Source="") which are load-fatal in WinUI 3.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire remaining session — it would have named the fix directly.
